title: Live DOM and accessibility observation
objective: Bind live DOM and accessibility observation to exact workspace, browser profile, page, origin, page generation, document generation, and server-issued node identity, with bounded nodes, depth, bytes, time, and concurrency, password and secret redaction, and denial of arbitrary JavaScript, generic CDP, DevTools, credential storage reads, and caller-defined selectors as authority.

include: server-issued typed node identity bound to workspace, profile, page, origin, page and document generations
bounded observation: node count, depth, bytes, execution time, concurrent observations
password and secret content redaction in observations, records, logs, and evidence
denial of arbitrary JavaScript, generic CDP, DevTools, and credential storage reads
denial of caller-defined selectors as authority
real integration tests for observation binding, bounds, and redaction
exclude: new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority
any caller-reachable evaluation or debugging surface

authority_delta.filesystem: None beyond the SG-000074 dedicated ephemeral automation profile directory owned by Deskal.
authority_delta.process: None beyond the SG-000074 Deskal-supervised low-authority browser child process family.
authority_delta.network: None beyond SG-000075 governed navigation decisions for the isolated host.
authority_delta.browser: Read-only observation only. No actuation, scripting, debugging, or credential access.
authority_delta.secrets: None. Password and secret content is redacted and never enters records, logs, or evidence.

invariants: stale page, document, or node identities fail closed
no evaluation or debugging surface ever appears

acceptance.claim: Observations bind exact workspace, profile, page, origin, page generation, document generation, and server-issued node identity within explicit numeric bounds, proven by binding tests.
Password and secret content is redacted everywhere, and arbitrary JavaScript, generic CDP, DevTools, credential reads, and caller-defined selectors as authority are denied.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000077: SG-000077 may activate only after SG-000076 closes canonically with bound observation as its base.

done_when: Bound live DOM and accessibility observation exists with redacted secrets and no evaluation surface, proven by binding and adversarial tests.
